players.product: Platinum Pro single-molecule protein sequencer and Proteus platform

quarterly_data.signal: Quantum-Si signed a lease (effective June 18, 2026) for approximately 54,374 square feet of planned office, laboratory and manufacturing space at 9955 Pacific Heights Boulevard, San Diego, to support Proteus platform development and expanded manufacturing capabilities, in a planned transition from its existing San Diego space, whose lease is expected to expire on December 31, 2027; the 120-month term is anticipated to commence on or about September 1, 2027.
quarterly_data.figure: approximately 54,374 square feet; 120-month term from about September 1, 2027
